name: YITAMOTOR Hard Tri-Fold Truck Bed Tonneau Cover Compatible with 2020-2026 Jeep Gladiator JT, 5 ft Bed with or without Trail Rail System

claims.verbatim: Element-Proof Cargo Cover: Crafted with high-quality FRP sheet, our truck bed tonneau cover offers excellent scratch resistance and protection against different weather elements including rain, snow, dirt, and UV rays. Enjoy reliable durability without fading, cracking, or peeling

All-around Strength: Non-slip FRP sheet works with PP honeycomb structure to achieve bearing capacity up to 450 pounds; Embedded clamps and reinforced latches prevent accidental opening during driving for increased safety; Includes LED light to facilitate item retrieval in dim or dark conditions

conflicts.resolution: Do not select FRP or PVC as a unified material fact before brand confirmation.

description:
YITAMOTOR factory brand packaging, Each cover is custom-built to ensure precise compatibility with the truck. Made from high-quality, commercial-grade vinyl that will not stretch, fade or crack.
Fitment
2020 2021 2022 2023 2024 2025 2026 Jeep Gladiator JT
NOTE:
Please measure your truck bed size or contact your dealer to confirm the correct model before ordering.
Cab size does not matter as long as you have the correct model and bed size.
Features
Compatibility: Compatible with Jeep Gladiator 5' bed of 2020 2021 2022 2023 2024 2025 2026 FIT for with or without Trail Rail System
Element-Proof Cargo Cover: Crafted with high-quality FRP sheet, our truck bed tonneau cover offers excellent scratch resistance and protection against different weather elements including rain, snow, dirt, and UV rays. Enjoy reliable durability without fading, cracking, or peeling
No-drill Installation: Install the hard tri-fold tonneau cover in no time without any drilling or modifications needed; Comes with detailed instructions for added convenience; Note that if your truck has cargo racks, remove them before installing this cover
All-around Strength: Non-slip FRP sheet works with PP honeycomb structure to achieve bearing capacity up to 450 pounds; Embedded clamps and reinforced latches prevent accidental opening during driving for increased safety; Includes LED light to facilitate item retrieval in dim or dark conditions
Easy Folding and Warning: Gain flexible bed access by single, dual, or tri-folding the cover and securing with nylon straps; Please be sure to install the tonneau cover as specified by the instructions, and tighten all the bolts before driving; Never drive with the cover partially open
